scope: Default production graph with no references; verifies unavailable state, not real segmentation quality. Reviewed reference-assisted and frozen-data recipes remain pending laboratory inputs.

checkout_identity.hash_policy: Raw checked-out bytes as used by the production result revision; hashes are not normalized Git blob hashes.
checkout_identity.newline_policy: The captured seven implementation files contain CRLF. Exact result-revision replay requires the recorded raw bytes. Other checkout policies yield different result identities even if calculations are equivalent.
